candidate_contract.structural_acceptance_only: Exact response delimiters, valid Python AST, required interface/constants, allowed imports, and forbidden-call checks. Generated code is not imported or executed in this gate.

claim_boundary: Fresh local P0-only candidate generation and static structural validation only; no generated candidate behavior, OIA, real ARC action, hosted/API model, or Track B claim.

future_execution.next_gate: Merge the opaque deterministic candidate package, then freeze an isolated candidate runner, exact action-word boundary, P0 replay, behavior deduplication, adapter, and allowed verdicts before any candidate execution.

input_boundary.prompt_inputs: Canonical P0 text raster, action names, one frozen epistemic stance, opaque candidate id, and executable interface contract only.

pre_freeze_model_access.purpose: Verify that the exact local snapshot loads under the pinned runtime; no prompt or generation was evaluated.

repairs.reason: Avoid adaptive prompt changes after seeing model outputs; structural failures are preserved as candidate rejections.
